# Startup Web Support

> Startup Web Support (SWS) is a  IT development, custom software engineering, mobile application, and digital marketing company based in Patna, Bihar, India. SWS builds scalable web applications, enterprise software, cross-platform iOS & Android mobile apps, and results-driven digital marketing and SEO campaigns for startups, SMEs, and established enterprises.

Startup Web Support provides end-to-end technology solutions from concept and UI/UX design to cloud deployment and marketing. This document provides an LLM-friendly index of services, software products, and documentation following the llms.txt standard.

## Core IT & Software Services

- [Web Development Company in Patna](https://startupwebsupport.com/web-development-company-in-patna): Full-stack custom web development using Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern tech stacks for high-performance websites and web applications.
- [Custom Software Development](https://startupwebsupport.com/software-development): Bespoke enterprise software engineering, business process automation, ERPs, and cloud solutions.
- [Mobile App Development Services in Patna](https://startupwebsupport.com/mobile-app-development-services-in-patna): Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using Flutter, React Native, and Swift/Kotlin.
- [E-Commerce Website Development](https://startupwebsupport.com/ecommerce-website-development): Secure, scalable online stores with multi-vendor support, payment gateways, and inventory management.
- [Domain & Cloud Hosting](https://startupwebsupport.com/domain-and-hosting): Reliable domain registration, managed cloud servers, SSL certificates, and web hosting infrastructure.
- [SMS & Push Notification Services](https://startupwebsupport.com/sms-push-notification): High-deliverability transactional and promotional SMS gateways and real-time push notifications.

## Ready-to-Deploy Software Products

- [Hospital Management System](https://startupwebsupport.com/hospital-management-system): Complete hospital and clinic ERP covering OPD/IPD, doctor appointments, billing, pharmacy, and patient records.
- [Pathology Management System](https://startupwebsupport.com/pathology-management-system): Diagnostic laboratory software with sample tracking, automated report generation, barcode scanning, and WhatsApp report delivery.
- [Pathology Software](https://startupwebsupport.com/pathology): Dedicated diagnostic lab billing, test report management, and patient portal.
- [Cab Booking App Solution](https://startupwebsupport.com/cab-booking-app): On-demand taxi dispatch and ride-hailing platform with rider app, driver app, real-time GPS tracking, and admin dashboard.
- [E-Commerce Website Solution](https://startupwebsupport.com/ecommerce-website): Pre-built multi-category ecommerce marketplace platform with cart, checkout, payment integrations, and order tracking.
